caption: The drawing shows a knee-length, long-sleeved dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt, rendered in a light tan or beige color with a subtle crosshatch pattern suggesting fabric texture. The dress features a matching bolero-style jacket with a rounded collar and flowing sleeves edged at the cuffs. Both the jacket and dress are decorated with symmetrical white leaf and vine motifs, with the decoration forming vertical lines on the bodice and front of the skirt, as well as following the edges of the jacket and cuffs. Additional vine patterns run horizontally along the lower edge of the skirt. The mannequin has no visible head, hands, or feet, focusing attention on the clothing. In the upper right of the composition, there is a smaller, simple line drawing of the same dress design, positioned to show the entire outline and embroidery pattern in less detail. In the lower right corner, part of an orange fabric or object appears, cut off by the edge of the image. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Boys's Dress
